title: The same kilo

lines.text: Leftover meat in the power cut

payout_note: ₹[__]/kg: the payout is not set. No source shows a renderer paying vendors; in the Kerala precedent, shops pay.

beliefs.before: Waste is my problem to dump cheaply
beliefs.after: My waste is worth money if I keep it clean

beliefs.before: Anything official will cost me money
beliefs.after: The hub is the market's own

beliefs.before: A fridge isn't worth it with these power cuts
beliefs.after: I can keep stock cold without buying one

beliefs.before: Leftover meat is a loss I just take
beliefs.after: Leftovers wait overnight in Chamber A, free
